api.note: Where the titles, depot keys and tokens come from. The app holds none of them: it asks this server, signed by this device's own key. public_key is the server's pinned Ed25519 key - print it with `npm run key` on the server box and paste it here; a reply that is not signed by that key is refused. base is that server's address: 127.0.0.1:8791 is the copy on this machine, and a build handed to other people points at https://steamar.cc instead. When you rotate the server key, this field changes in the same release.

vendor.note: Where the three helper files come from. SteaMar downloads the first source that answers, unpacks the DLLs into vendor/ beside the app and installs from there. Each source names the sha256 of every DLL it must deliver: a file that does not match is refused, from a download or from a folder, because these files run inside Steam. A new source or version needs its checksums here too.

data_files.note: Nothing is downloaded into the app any more: the tables are served. The clones under data/ are operator material for the importer on the server box, not something a running app needs.
